trip.travelLimit: Activities within ~1 hour travel of a central-Strip hotel by bus (RTC Deuce, 24/7), Monorail (east Strip), or short rideshare
trip.note: Las Vegas has NO subway. Public transit is RTC bus + Las Vegas Monorail. Everything on the Strip is well within 1 hour of any central Strip hotel by Deuce bus/monorail; downtown (Fremont) is one Deuce ride away; Red Rock Canyon is off-Strip and may exceed 1 hour by bus.
